run_download_nymeria_dataset: run the CLI to download the Nymeria dataset from a URL JSON file to a target directory
run_download_with_match_key: run the download CLI with a custom match key to filter which sequences to download
run_download_selective_groups: run the download CLI with selective data groups by editing get_groups to comment out unwanted groups
review_get_groups: review the get_groups function to see which DataGroups are selected for download
refactor_get_groups: refactor get_groups to conditionally include or exclude DataGroups based on a full boolean flag
